Pass an Arrow table through unchanged.

PipelineOperatorFactory owns this Data Studio table operation. The output retains the input table's rows, columns, schema, and values.

## Where it runs

| Where | Runs |

| Data pipeline (run the graph, **Run step**, previews) | Yes; the result can be saved as a table |
